title: Prove the sharp native format at the rank-seven A13 half-ADD
body:
## Summary

Close one native-conversion part of PR3083/3084's released A13 handoff. The actual forward source83 warp, target126 climb and half-ADD require the following sharp local format for independent signed P-bit normalized input components:

```text
fractional bits = 2
signed width    = P + 5
P = 64          = 69 bits
```

The physical warp `T_[45] K52 T_[382]^-1` is a Gaussian monomial and differs from the logical `K52`. Exact source-bound prefix replay identifies the four-field dirty target; all 512-column native operator comparisons, attaining format failures and literal 69-bit half-ADD fixtures pass for both providers. Adds only `research/rank7-native-half-boundary/`.

[Proof, sources, receipts and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/1e47220c44a90976f1b53289f643794bad1aadfe/research/rank7-native-half-boundary). [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-18984281). Base main `d8e0f83f`, priority revision 6, unchanged at the submission checkpoint.

## Evidence

- Before: the scalar-grid certificates explicitly omit native conversions. After: exact Gaussian interpretation gives final component range `±(5*2^(P-1)-9/4)`, a sharp quarter grid and width `P+5`; whole native numerators and partial sums fit the same format. The local scalar-only comparison needs two fewer total bits. This does not establish a global native precision bound.
- Fresh retained native transport/emission, new sparse Fraction evaluation and the retained packed-integer evaluator agree. The actual aligned bit caller preserves its source and returns 68 clean carries; a 68-bit caller rejects the extremal endpoints. Its conditional sequential ADD tariff is 553,984 Boolean gates over 1,024 components. Production, routing and non-ADD costs remain additional.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay, 15 optimized behavioral groups, optimized receipt equality, Ruff and source compilation pass. Internal read-only review found and resolved hidden-warp dependency and mutable-trace bugs. A read-only Git-free export replays identically, and all 33 committed-file byte comparisons pass. Hosted CI and independent human review remain separate.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-native-half-boundary
```

`RUN/tmp` is an existing external session directory. The package uses only the standard library.

Credit PR3083/3084, PR3080/3081, PR3076/3078/3060/3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis, DLamdata, icekylinx and the retained Gaussian/native/geometry/owner lineage. Frozen sources and notices remain byte-identical. Development used substantial automated assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

This is a conditional local native-format theorem. The complete physical prefix/adapter interpretation, approximate child errors, actual dual contract, ownership, consumer/restoration and full supplier/outer invoice remain open. No new kappa, scientific supplier admission, selected-frontier change or modification to shared validators/frozen predecessors is claimed. Next: bind the five input fields to a paid physical producer and trace the actual subsequent consumers while retaining the quarter bits.
